name: Deposit Completeness Contract
governs: What a FINISHED deposit carries beyond its canonical bytes: authored wiki article (WIKI-002, ≥60 words), defines_concepts (CONCEPTS-001), related_deposits (RELATED-001), a lexical-minting receipt (LEX-001), citation-graph edges for every body AXN reference (CITE-001), an artifact-free rendered record carrying its own AXN (RENDER-001), and verified declared files (FILES-001). Attested absence is explicit: concepts_attested_none / related_attested_none / lexical_attested_none — absence must be a decision, never a default. Enforced by scripts/deposit_completeness.py as the pipeline `completeness` stage before commit; fails closed.
origin: MINT #1443/#1444 repair session, 2026-08-09: both deposits shipped with empty LLM-tier fields, no lexical receipt, and records rendered before the citation graph existed; the only element that shipped complete was the only one with a hard gate (WIKI-001).

rules.desc: lexical-minting-registry rows for this deposit or lexical_attested_none
every body AXN reference present as a citation-graph edge
record page exists, carries its AXN, zero literal-markdown artifacts
every declared file exists with matching sha256 and bytes

EVID-001.rule: A write-up that measures a captured observation carries that capture, or states where it is preserved.
EVID-001.scope: Not a citation rule. Triggers only where the body both MEASURES a captured observation (composed card, SERP state, fetched page, session transcript) and quantifies it. A bibliography points at material any reader can re-fetch; a capture points at a system state that no longer exists and cannot be reconstructed by anyone, including its author. That irrecoverability is the whole basis of the rule.
EVID-001.out_of_scope: Research notes mapping recoverable sources; source maps and reference works; theory without measured captures.
satisfied_by: an exhibit section (appendix, exhibits, evidence, verification record, capture record), numbered headings permitted
an explicit statement that THIS deposit's exhibits are preserved at a named record or dataset
not_satisfied_by: a round-log line, which names the rounds without carrying them
apparatus vocabulary — naming the capture registry as an instrument is not a claim that this paper's evidence is in it
a queued or pending registry entry, which is a promise rather than a location
EVID-001.calibration_note: Each exclusion above was a false negative in an earlier draft, found by testing the checker against #1546 — the deposit whose omission motivated the rule. A checker that clears its own motivating case has not been tested.
